priceData.title: Price Data Disclaimer
priceData.content: The card price data provided on this platform comes from third-party sources (including but not limited to SNKRDUNK, eBay, etc.) and is for reference only. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the price data. Actual transaction prices may vary due to market fluctuations, seller pricing strategies, card conditions, and other factors. Users should verify price information on their own before making any transactions.

investmentRisk.title: Investment Risk Warning
investmentRisk.content: Pokémon card collecting and trading involves investment risks. Card prices may fluctuate significantly due to market supply and demand, trends, grading changes, and other factors. The data and analysis tools provided on this platform do not constitute investment advice. Users should carefully evaluate based on their own financial situation and risk tolerance, and assume all responsibility and consequences for investment decisions. Past price performance does not represent future returns.

dataDelay.title: Data Delay Notice
dataDelay.content: The price data on this platform may be delayed, and the update frequency depends on the availability of data sources and system scheduling (usually updated every 12 hours). The displayed prices do not represent real-time market prices and may differ from current actual transaction prices. When making trading decisions, users should refer to multiple sources and confirm the latest price information.

externalLinks.title: External Links Disclaimer
externalLinks.content: This platform provides links to external websites (such as SNKRDUNK, eBay, etc.) to facilitate users in querying detailed information or conducting transactions. We are not responsible for the content, privacy policies, security, or trading behaviors of these external websites. When visiting external websites and conducting transactions, users should assess risks on their own and comply with the terms and conditions of those websites.

serviceInterruption.title: Service Interruption and Changes
serviceInterruption.content: This platform may temporarily interrupt service due to system maintenance, technical upgrades, force majeure, or other reasons. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or terminate part or all of the services at any time without prior notice. We are not responsible for any losses caused by service interruptions, data loss, or feature changes.

jurisdiction.title: Legal Jurisdiction and Dispute Resolution
jurisdiction.content: This disclaimer and platform services are governed by the laws of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Any disputes arising from the use of this platform should first be resolved through friendly negotiation; if negotiation fails, they should be submitted to the jurisdiction of the Taipei District Court in Taiwan. If any provision of this disclaimer is deemed invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain valid.

userConduct.title: User Conduct Guidelines
userConduct.content: When using this platform, users must not engage in the following behaviors: (1) Using crawlers or automated tools to scrape data in large quantities; (2) Attempting unauthorized access to systems or databases; (3) Distributing malware or conducting cyber attacks; (4) Impersonating others or providing false information; (5) Engaging in any illegal activities or infringement of others' rights. Violators will have their service usage rights terminated and may be held legally liable.

dataPrivacy.title: Data Privacy and Protection
dataPrivacy.content: This platform values user privacy and will not sell, rent, or otherwise disclose user personal information to third parties. We only use user data within the scope of providing services, improving user experience, and complying with legal requirements. For specific privacy policies, please refer to the 'Privacy Policy' page. Users have the right to request to view, modify, or delete their personal information.
